workItems.title: Provider observation snapshots
workItems.goal: Represent explicit GitHub, Vercel, and Supabase observations as safe file-based evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: A versioned provider-observations schema defines supported read-only facets.
Safe example fixtures contain no credentials or environment values.
Foundation verification validates the provider observation contract.

workItems.title: Proposal-only proof refresh drafts
workItems.goal: Compare observed provider evidence with registry truth and render reviewable drafts without mutating the registry.
acceptanceCriteria: Proof refresh emits JSON and Markdown drafts under .foundation.
Draft generation never mutates data/projects.json.
Registry-only and external-observation modes are documented and verified.

workItems.title: Observation and mutation separation
workItems.goal: Keep provider observation, proposal, approval, and registry mutation as separate authority stages.
acceptanceCriteria: Proposal artifacts declare no mutation authority.
Approved registry change bundles remain separate from provider observation.
Foundation documentation preserves explicit operator review before registry edits.

workItems.title: Stale-proof refresh queue
workItems.goal: Turn stale-proof classifications into a deterministic, reviewable refresh queue without granting provider or registry mutation authority.
acceptanceCriteria: Queue entries use stable project-scoped identities and source evidence references.
Repeated generation from unchanged inputs produces identical queue ordering and content.
Queue entries distinguish observation work from any later mutation request.
Foundation verification covers empty, current-proof, stale-proof, and conflicting-proof inputs.

workItems.title: File-based live provider observation inputs
workItems.goal: Accept explicit provider observation files before introducing any direct provider read adapter.
acceptanceCriteria: The CLI accepts an explicit provider observation input path.
Manual capture normalization produces contract-valid runtime artifacts.
All generated observation artifacts remain private runtime output.

workItems.title: Direct provider read adapters
workItems.goal: Add receipt-backed read-only GitHub, Vercel, and Supabase observation adapters while retaining file input as a supported fallback.
acceptanceCriteria: Every adapter is read-only and records provider, scope, observation time, and evidence identity.
No credential value, cookie, token, or environment value is persisted in Foundation artifacts.
Unavailable or denied provider surfaces remain explicit rather than inferred.
File-based observation input remains supported and contract-compatible.

workItems.title: Supabase inventory draft contract
workItems.goal: Represent read-only Supabase database and security posture without mutating Supabase.
acceptanceCriteria: The inventory schema covers project, schema, RLS, auth, storage, function, migration, and advisor evidence.
Draft rendering is input-bound and read-only.
Fixtures and verification reject unsafe secret-bearing examples.

workItems.title: Desired, observed, and health state separation
workItems.goal: Keep desired project state, observed provider state, and Foundation health judgment as separate machine fields.
acceptanceCriteria: Every required project has split desired, observed, and health state.
Verification rejects invalid split-state values.
Generated console data preserves the split state.

workItems.title: Explainable health scorecards
workItems.goal: Summarize proof, deployment, and data posture without replacing source evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: Required projects have scored or explicitly pending scorecards.
Every score includes explainable dimensions and a next action.
Accepted private-source policy remains explicit and does not create false warnings.

workItems.title: Approved registry change bundles
workItems.goal: Convert reviewed proposal artifacts into explicit manual registry-edit instructions without granting automatic mutation authority.
acceptanceCriteria: Bundles bind source identity, affected projects, operations, evidence, and approval state.
Proposed bundles retain pending approval and mutationAuthority none.
Runtime bundle artifacts remain ignored.

workItems.title: Playbook read-interface bridge
workItems.goal: Project Playbook verification and governance artifacts without executing or replacing Playbook.
acceptanceCriteria: The read-interface schema preserves per-repository provenance.
Draft ingestion performs no registry mutation.
Foundation verification covers the example contract.

workItems.title: Lifeline execution receipt bridge
workItems.goal: Project Lifeline execution and deployment receipts without making Foundation the executor.
acceptanceCriteria: Receipt projection preserves target, action, approval, rollback, and health evidence.
Projection artifacts remain proposal-only runtime state.
Foundation gains no execution or deployment authority.

workItems.title: Privacy remediation tracking
workItems.goal: Track Fitness privacy remediation while preserving Supabase and owner-repository mutation boundaries.
acceptanceCriteria: Remediation records preserve severity, status, owner, evidence, and next actions.
Tracking does not mutate Supabase or Fitness.
Resolved posture requires explicit remediation evidence.

workItems.title: Deterministic roadmap next command
workItems.goal: Expose the stable machine roadmap through a read-only human and JSON next-work command.
acceptanceCriteria: foundation roadmap next reads only FOUNDATION_ROADMAP.json.
Completed work is excluded unless explicitly requested.
Human and JSON output preserve IDs, lifecycle, dependencies, unknown priority, and source revision.
Repeated reads from unchanged input produce identical ordering.

workItems.title: Cross-app privacy and data contracts
workItems.goal: Define reusable privacy-first data boundaries for Fitness, wellness, Mazer, Trove, and future applications.
acceptanceCriteria: Versioned contracts cover profile, consent, sensitive data, retention, deletion, ownership, sharing, and audit receipts.
Product-specific extensions cannot weaken shared privacy semantics.
Fixtures and verification cover allowed, denied, unknown, and revoked states.

workItems.title: Foundation product operating layer
workItems.goal: Finish Foundation as the trusted operator dashboard for project health, data posture, deployment proof, and safe next actions.
acceptanceCriteria: Registry, proof, deployment, data, Playbook, and Lifeline projections are current and source-linked.
The console explains blockers and recommended next actions without claiming owner authority.
Operator routing preserves approval and production deployment gates.
A complete local verification and browser proof cover the operator workflow.

workItems.title: Foundation control-plane truth reconciliation
workItems.goal: Reconcile the canonical Foundation GitHub identity and current remote evidence across config, registry, generated surfaces, fixtures, setup docs, and Atlas projection.
acceptanceCriteria: The canonical GitHub repository identity is verified from live remote evidence.
Foundation config, data/projects.json, generated docs, console data, fixtures, and setup guidance agree on that identity.
Historical promotion evidence remains immutable and clearly dated.
Foundation build and verify pass, and Atlas root projection is refreshed separately.
